pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with sub-rounded vertices and moderately smooth edge gradients; spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, appearing largest on the shoulder and decreasing in size towards the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a lattice; junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections with a pixel thickness of approximately 5-10 percent of the adjacent patch diameter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the upper neck displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette consisting of short, dark, erect hair fibers.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized cluster of small, dark, irregular textural disruptions and pitted marks is visible on the lower-central flank area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized pitting and dark irregular marks on the lower flank, potentially representing parasitic lesions or healed physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple avian symbionts (oxpeckers) perched on the upper neck and back; tail is visible and positioned across the posterior flank.
